bank.quality: max(0, entropy(validation class frequency) - validation BCE - 0.005)
bank.coassociation: normalized squared input weights weighted by absolute outgoing paths; fitness-weighted mean
bank.mask_control: same accepted candidates and quality weights; replace fitted values by binary masks

rules: A complete source solution is not required: use partial solutions that beat a constant-class-probability predictor on validation BCE.
Do not weight or select source models using source final evaluation labels.
Pool all four completed search schemes; report quality mass and structural diagnostics per source scheme separately.
Extract balanced input groups and paired higher groups without teacher labels; freeze priors before generating new tasks.
Teacher groups are used only for structural diagnostics, label generation, and the explicitly privileged oracle control.
A shuffled prior preserves mask sizes but permutes input coordinates; it is not selected against teacher groups.
Tune each transfer method's learning rate only on two new tuning tasks.
Evaluate eight separate new complete tasks of the same family; weights restart without source weight transfer.
Compare BCE and both-class recall, even when no method attains 97% accuracy.
This extension was designed after seeing source failures; fresh target tasks remain independent of that development.
